## Downloads

> The **Source code** links at the bottom are added by GitHub to every release automatically. To use CausVane, download the file for your system below.

**Install it** (recommended: adds CausVane to your applications, like any other program):

| System | File | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 and 11 | `CausVane-Windows-Setup.exe` | Double-click it and follow the steps. No administrator rights needed; CausVane appears in the Start menu and on the desktop, and can be removed from **Settings → Apps → Installed apps**. |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `CausVane-macOS.dmg` | Double-click it and drag **CausVane** onto **Applications**. The first time, right-click CausVane in Applications and choose **Open**, because it isn't signed by Apple. |
| Ubuntu, Debian | `CausVane-Linux.deb` | Double-click it to open it in your software installer, then click **Install**. |
| Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE | `CausVane-Linux.rpm` | Double-click it to open it in your software installer, then click **Install**. |

**Or run it without installing** (unpack and start; delete the folder to remove it):

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `CausVane-Windows-Portable.zip`: extract it and start `CausVane.exe` inside the `CausVane` folder. |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `CausVane-macOS.zip`: double-click it and start **CausVane**. |
| Linux | `CausVane-Linux.tar.gz`: extract it and start `CausVane/bin/CausVane`. |

Every download includes its own Java, so nothing else needs to be installed.

See the [README](https://github.com/AhmedAbdelaty22/CausVane#readme) for what CausVane does and how to use it.
